text:
Our 11 y. old son (complex spine issues) was examined (we were impressed with level of detail) and had excercises for several days here.

Highly professional physio with a pleasant approach and nice attitude.

You can tell he invested much work in his education/expertise.

He has identified a few important points missed previously back in europe.

Exceeded our expectations by far, great professional. Fully reccomended.

I came in with severe SI joint pain, and I left feeling little to no pain at all. He even showed me exercises to do on my own if it flared up again. He was very thorough and asked the right questions to find the root issue. Other clinics refused to see me because I am 5 months pregnant, but this one was very kind and accommodating. He spoke English very well, and we had no issues communicating at all.
Got me right in good exams meds and only 900 Bhat! Cheers my first doctor abroad.

I can highly recommend this physiotherapist. I have visited him on two separate occasions for different Injuries and he is attentive, professional and experienced. His English language skills are good so it is possible to both describe details of the injury and pain experienced and receive good explanations of treatments, causes and exercises - which the doctor will readily do. He is generous with his time and his manner. The clinic is well equipped with the latest technologies for treatment and exercise.

At Thitipong I had my first manual therapist session after I tried a chiropractor, fysiotherapist, osteopath, yoga, dry-needling in The Netherlands. Luckily I have my MRI images on my phone to show my L5-S1 herniated disc and scoliosis …

I slept on my shoulder wrong, the most excruciating pain ive had in years. Booked an appointment and was seen to promptly. Great treatment and he knew his stuff! Clinic was very clean with all the newest equipment. I can finally breath and move again with minimal discomfort! Highly recommend this clinic!
Best Physio I have ever had, was knowledgeable, funny and very attentive to enquiries!

An excellent physical rehabilitation specialist. Proficient in many "gold standard" techniques—Mulligan, Mackenzie, Pear, yoga therapy, exercise therapy, etc.

If something hurts, bothers you, or you've had an injury, it's definitely worth trying. She provides recommendations and exercises.
